visual_enhancers.borders: Soft organic shapes. Use rounded-3xl or rounded-[2rem] for containers, rounded-full for buttons and pills.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Very subtle, warm diffuse shadows. shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(62,54,46,0.06)]
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle grain overlays. Use CSS radial gradients to mimic soft blooms of sage and terracotta in the background.
visual_enhancers.placeholders: CRITICAL: Do NOT use image tags with external URLs. Use styled div blocks. Class example: `w-full h-full min-h-[300px] bg-[#EAE5DE]/40 border-2 border-dashed border-[#B5A79A]/30 rounded-[2rem] flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-[#63584D] p-8 text-center italic font-serif`. Text inside should be descriptive (e.g., 'Mosolygós terapeuta portré', 'Meleg hangulatú, növényekkel teli szoba').

layouts.marketing: Generous spacing (py-24 to py-32). Asymmetrical grid layouts. Use padding p-8 inside cards.
layouts.admin: Denser grid but maintaining the warm color palette. Solid white/cream cards on taupe background.
layouts.booking: Clear, step-by-step flow. High trust, minimal distractions. Center-aligned multi-step forms with warm accents.

motion.transitions: duration-500 ease-out. Soft fades for page transitions and hover states.
motion.hover: Buttons gently lift (-translate-y-1) and increase shadow. Background colors slightly darken.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped (`rounded-full`). Primary: `bg-[#7A5C50] text-white hover:bg-[#63584D]`. Secondary: `bg-transparent border border-[#B5A79A] text-[#7A5C50] hover:bg-[#F3EFEA]`.
components.cards: Solid soft backgrounds (`bg-white` or `bg-[#FCFBF9]`). Large radii (`rounded-3xl`). 1px subtle border (`border-[#EAE5DE]`).
components.header: Sticky navigation. MUST use solid background or heavy glass (`backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#FAF8F5]/90`). No transparent headers that obscure text.
components.forms: Inputs: `bg-white border-[#EAE5DE] rounded-xl text-[#3E362E] placeholder:text-[#9A8F83]`. Focus: `ring-2 ring-[#A3B19B] outline-none`.

images.strategy: No images. Use descriptive placeholder blocks exclusively. The client will supply real photos later. Do not use external stock photos.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text contrast meets APCA/WCAG standards. Do not use white text on sage or terracotta unless contrast is verified; use deep brown text instead.
accessibility.attributes: Add data-testid attributes to all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links, tabs).

instructions_to_main_agent: Configure tailwind.config.js with the custom colors provided in the guidelines.
The project uses .js/.jsx files NOT .tsx. Generate components in JavaScript and remove TypeScript types.
For marketing pages (Home, About, Services), use custom HTML/Tailwind for asymmetric, organic layouts.
For Admin panel and Booking flow, leverage shadcn/ui components heavily but customize them to match the warm, soft, non-corporate aesthetic.
Strictly follow the requirement for CSS PLACEHOLDER BLOCKS with descriptive Hungarian text. DO NOT render any external image URLs.
Ensure all text is in Hungarian as requested ('Teret adunk a változásnak.', 'IDŐPONTOT FOGLALOK', stb.).
Include an Admin dashboard with CRUD operations for team, services, workshops, and bookings.
Add 'data-testid' attributes to all interactive elements to support robust automated testing.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not make generic centered layouts. Use asymmetrical layouts and soft organic shapes. Layered shadows and warm tones are required. Never use generic 'AI slop' aesthetics like purple gradients or tech-heavy glowing borders. Use custom scrollbars with no gutter. Always ensure header has a readable background. Use 'sonner' for toast notifications. Do not use placeholder images from external services; build CSS-based descriptive placeholder blocks instead.
